title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: View Message from Dr. Kiran C. Patel Dr. Kiran C. Patel grew up ethnically to Asian-Indian Parents in Africa, was educated under the British Educational System, and then got his Diplomas from Cambridge University and The University of London. Then, he graduated in Medicine at Medical College in Gujarat, did his residency in Internal Medicine in New Jersey, and completed a Cardiology program affiliated with Columbia University of New York.
